premises.text: Consumers can top up and manage the connected card remotely from phone, hotel, or home city
premises.evidence_span: They can top up their card while on their way to the bus, while waiting for the bus from the hotel room or even from their home city

premises.text: Every phone becomes a ticket sales channel without physical sales infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: You don't need a physical infrastructure for that. Instead, every phone becomes a sales channel

premises.text: The Fidesmo card integrates into existing public-transport infrastructure
premises.evidence_span: the Videsmo card integrates seamlessly into their existing infrastructure

premises.text: Monetization takes a percentage of public-transport ticket sales
premises.evidence_span: we intend to sell a lot of tickets and take a percentage on those

premises.text: Distribution reaches consumers through public transport operators
premises.evidence_span: The Fidesmo card will reach the hands of the consumers via public transport operators

premises.text: MyFair-based contactless standard enables one card to work across many cities
premises.evidence_span: 70% of all contactless ticketing systems in the world are based on MyFair, and we intend to take advantage of that

premises.text: An open API platform lets partners add loyalty, hotel-key, and secure-access services on the card
premises.evidence_span: Fidesmo is, at the core, an API. We invite other companies to build services on top of our platform

premises.text: The connected card is managed and updated from the cloud and can move into the phone later
premises.evidence_span: the connected card that can be managed and updated from the cloud
